name: lumi-skill-cad-drafting
description: Source-grounded CAD drafting tools with visible AutoCAD MCP playback, renovation-folder analysis, explicit editable DXF drafts, space programs, and drawing QA checklists.

lumi.setupNote: Reads real local renovation sources, prepares source-grounded drafting data, and visibly plays validated operations into Windows AutoCAD through Lumi MCP COM automation. A generated DXF is available only as an explicitly requested file deliverable; it is never an AutoCAD-completion fallback. Visible AutoCAD execution has no generated-file, LISP, SCRIPT, batch-command, or cursor fallback. This is not an Autodesk-official MCP server. Production drawings still require professional verification.
